query:
UPDATE core.tenders
                           SET trading_at = (
                             refdata.add_business_days(
                               (core.now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Almaty')::date,
                               $2
                             )::timestamp + time '10:00'
                           ) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Almaty'
                           WHERE id = $1
                           RETURNING trading_at AS "trading_at!"
